title: Interpretation of Scripture
definition: Interpretation of Scripture is the careful effort to understand the meaning God intended when He inspired the biblical text.
summary: Faithful interpretation seeks the author's intended meaning by considering context, genre, historical background, grammar, and the broader message of Scripture.
christFocus: Jesus taught that all Scripture ultimately points to Him. Faithful interpretation seeks to understand each passage within God's unfolding plan of redemption fulfilled in Christ.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The goal of interpretation is not personal preference but discovering what God has communicated through His Word.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Poor interpretation can produce false doctrine, confusion, and spiritual harm. Sound interpretation protects believers and strengthens the church.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Study passages in context, compare Scripture with Scripture, seek wise counsel when needed, and always approach God's Word with humility.
